A maximum of five (5) qualified individuals may be awarded this scholarship for each of these starts. Scholarships will be awarded on a first-come, first-served basis. Applicants for this scholarship opportunity must provide documentation of current employment as either a Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) or Patient Care Technician (PCT).</p><p dir="ltr">Scholarship recipients will be responsible for all other associated costs, including but not limited to textbooks and any applicable fees. Scholarship awards are limited, non-transferable, and subject to verification of current employment as either a CNA or PCT and meeting all program admission and eligibility requirements.</p><p dir="ltr">This scholarship is available to first-time enrollees only. Students who withdraw, are administratively withdrawn, or are terminated from the program will forfeit the scholarship and will not be eligible to reapply or receive the scholarship in the future, even if they re-enroll.</p><p dir="ltr">This is a one-time scholarship opportunity for the specified start date(s) and is not renewable.
